title: 第461章 圣水第460章 你在狗叫什么
slug: 落魄贵族千金被迫成为我的女仆
lines: 就在这时，大厅前方的一个角落里，突然站起来一个头发花白、穿着破旧亚麻衣的老妇人。她颤巍巍地举起手，眼泪像断了线的珠子一样往下掉，声音嘶哑地哭喊道：
“使者大人！如果不是您，不是伟大的主，我那可怜的小孙子早就病死了啊！那些贪婪的医生要把我们赶出诊所，是您用圣水救了他，还给了我们过冬的粮食！主啊，您就是我们全家的再生父母！”
老妇人一边哭喊，一边竟然直接跪在了过道上，朝着台上的黑袍人连连磕头。
随着她这一跪，周围好几个看似互不相识的人也纷纷站了起来，一个个眼眶通红，声泪俱下地开始附和。
“没错！我也是！我本来已经打算去跳第戎河了，是教会的兄弟拉住了我……”
“主没有抛弃我们！在这里，我们就是一家人！”
一时间，整个大厅的氛围被瞬间点燃，那些原本只是为了贪图一个金币的鸡蛋或者免费香水而来的新人们，被这种狂热且悲情的氛围深深感染，不少人的眼神开始动摇。
唯有叶海一脸懵逼，不是，这演戏的进度也太快了吧。
你这要是放到叶海上辈子，这种剧情包骗不到人的。
但这一世么……叶海看着周围有些躁动的人们，无奈地叹了口气，这种手段对于没怎么见过世面的人们来说还真有着不小的杀伤力。
主要是他们也没经历过这种骗术。
当然，一旁的瓦伦丁也没信，以他骑士的超强目力，即便大厅昏暗，他也能清晰地看到那老妇人虽然衣服打满了补丁，但指甲缝却干干净净，完全不像是长期干粗活的底层贫民。
而且，那几个带头附和的人，哭喊的时候眼神还会时不时地互相交流一下，分明是在打配合。
再加上枫叶伯爵之前和他说过是来调查邪教的，因此瓦伦丁笃定，这几个要不是托，他把自己今年的薪水都给捐了！
当然，不信的也不止他。
还有两个注意力完全没在台上的女人也没信。
就在台上台下“感天动地”的时候，叶海突然感觉右边的大腿传来一阵轻柔的摩挲感。
他微微偏过头，只见凯瑟琳不知何时已经凑了过来。
这位成熟美艳的少妇借着昏暗的灯光，身子微微前倾，饱满的胸口几乎要贴上叶海的手臂。
她红润的嘴唇凑近叶海的耳畔，吐气如兰，压低声音呢喃道：“大人……这场面看起来真让人有些害怕呢。这些人怎么像疯了一样，难道是中了什么精神类的魔法吗？”
凯瑟琳虽然不是超凡者，但作为法师学徒的母亲，她那点贵妇人的见识还是有的。
她显然看出了这场讲座的诡异之处，但聪明如她，并没有大声声张，反而借着这个由头，十分自然地向叶海寻求起了“庇护”。
叶海感受着耳畔传来的温热气息和若有若无的幽香，嘶……
这女人怎么回事，想要当自己情人的不是她女儿吗？
他微微侧头，嘴唇几乎擦过凯瑟琳的耳垂，同样低声回应道：“一点不入流的心理暗示把戏罢了，连最低级的魔法都算不上。夫人不必惊慌，就当看一出拙劣的舞台剧好了。”
被叶海温热的呼吸扫过耳根，凯瑟琳身子微微一颤，眼底闪过一丝异彩，随后更加柔顺地靠回了椅背上，大腿依旧似有若无地紧贴着叶海，嘴角噙着一抹得逞的笑意。
content_en:
At this moment, in a corner in front of the hall, an old woman with gray hair and wearing shabby linen clothes suddenly stood up. She raised her hands tremblingly, tears falling down like broken beads, and cried hoarsely:
"Sir Messenger! If it weren't for you and the great Lord, my poor little grandson would have died of illness long ago! Those greedy doctors wanted to drive us out of the clinic, but you saved him with holy water and gave us food for the winter! Lord, you are the reborn parent of our family!"
While the old woman was crying, she knelt down in the aisle and kowtowed to the man in black robe on the stage.
As she knelt down, several people around her who seemed to be strangers to each other stood up one after another. Their eyes were red, and they started to echo with tears.
"That's right! Me too! I was already planning to jump into the Dijon River, but it was the church brothers who held me back..."
"The Lord has not abandoned us! Here, we are a family!"
For a time, the atmosphere in the entire hall was instantly ignited. The newcomers who originally came just for a gold coin of eggs or free perfume were deeply affected by this fanatical and tragic atmosphere, and many people's eyes began to waver.
Ye Hai was the only one who looked confused. No, the acting was progressing too fast.
If you were to leave Ye Hai for a lifetime, you wouldn't be able to deceive anyone with this kind of plot.
But in this life... Ye Hai looked at the agitated people around him and sighed helplessly. This method is really quite lethal to people who have never seen the world.
The main reason is that they have never experienced this kind of deception.
Of course, Valentine on the side didn't believe it. With his knight's super eyesight, even in the dark of the hall, he could clearly see that the old woman's clothes were patched, but her fingernails were clean. She didn't look like a low-class poor person who had been doing rough work for a long time.
Moreover, the few people who took the lead in echoing the cry would make eye contact with each other from time to time, clearly cooperating.
In addition, Earl Maple Leaf had told him before that he was here to investigate a cult, so Valentin was sure that if these people hadn't been entrusted by them, he would have donated all of his salary this year!
Of course, he wasn't the only one who didn't believe it.
The two women who were not paying attention at all on the stage didn't believe it either.
Just when he was "moving the world" on and off the stage, Ye Hai suddenly felt a gentle rubbing sensation coming from his right thigh.
He turned his head slightly and saw Catherine approaching him at some point.
Under the dim light, this mature and beautiful young woman leaned forward slightly, her plump chest almost touching Ye Hai's arm.
Her red lips were close to Ye Hai's ear, her breath was like blue, and she murmured in a low voice: "Sir... this scene looks really scary. Why are these people acting crazy? Are they under some kind of spiritual magic?"
Although Catherine is not a supernatural being, as the mother of a mage's apprentice, she still has the knowledge of a noble lady.
She obviously saw the weirdness of this lecture, but as smart as she was, she did not make a loud statement. Instead, she used this reason to naturally seek "asylum" from Ye Hai.
Ye Hai felt the warm breath and faint fragrance coming from his ears, and hissed...
What's going on with this woman? Isn't it her daughter who wants to be his lover?
He tilted his head slightly, his lips almost brushed Catherine's earlobe, and responded in the same low voice: "It's just a low-level psychological suggestion trick, not even the lowest level of magic. Madam, don't panic, just treat it as a clumsy stage play."
Catherine's body trembled slightly when Ye Hai's warm breath brushed her ears, a flash of light flashed in her eyes, and then she leaned back on the chair more supplely, her thighs still seeming to be close to Ye Hai, with a smile of success on her lips.
